title: Sessions offer to swap themselves for a fresh one on the next goal, and do it on the user's yes

fields.why: TJ asked for it; this session is long and its own work is done

text: Build requirements F1-F5 in app/DESIGN.md, section 'Swapping in a fresh session'. Reuse the Assistant's version: cmdClearContext in lib/overview.mjs writes clear-context.json to the channel; AppModel.clearAssistantIfAsked swaps the session. Generalise both to every session, keyed to a goal, refusing on checkpoint gaps, requiring --user-said. Recently ended (AppModel.confirmEnd/reopen) must keep the old conversation. Agent instructions in agent/*.md. Do not touch InspectorView, DashboardView, Snapshot.swift, SessionStrip.swift (another session holds them). Restart the app only with open -g.
